records.title: Ionenbildung mit der Edelgasregel deuten
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Kationen- und Anionenbildung mithilfe der Edelgasregel fachlich deuten.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can interpret the formation of cations and anions using the noble gas rule.
records.generatorProvenance: Raw sealed author input identifies ChatGPT/Codex builtin image generation; model id not separately exposed. Generator identity is not approval.
scienceAndRepresentationObservations: Na 2|8|1 gives one electron to Cl 2|8|7; Na+ becomes 2|8 and Cl- becomes 2|8|8. Electron sums11+17=10+18=28; ion charges +1 and -1 balance.
Schalenbelegung numbers replace falsely counted ring points. No countable dot model remains to contradict the stated occupancies.
Large atom/ion symbols, electron-transfer arrow and occupancy digits remain distinguishable at360 and680. Smaller explanatory labels are secondary; the core before/after counts and signs are visible.
records.actual360Verdict: PASS: principal symbols, charges, e- arrow and occupancy digits can be distinguished without magnifying the actual360 screenshot.
records.actual680Verdict: Personally seen: main motifs and detailed labels visible at680; any remaining geometry boundary explicitly retained.
records.representationAndScopeLimit: Orientation model of one Na/Cl electron transfer; no literal orbital/radius drawing or actual electron trajectory.
records.proposedBoundedAltTextDE: Natrium mit Schalenbelegung 2|8|1 gibt ein Elektron an Chlor mit 2|8|7 ab. Es entstehen das Kation Na⁺ mit 2|8 und das Anion Cl⁻ mit 2|8|8; die Außenschalen sind voll.
records.altTextStatus: inert proposal; for REVISE assets only after the actual image defect is resolved. Alt text does not fix raster legibility or geometry.

records.title: Salzformeln aus Ionenladungen ableiten
records.description: Die lernende Person kann aus Ionenladungen und Molekül-Ionen Verhältnisformeln von Salzen ableiten, Salznamen und Formeln ineinander überführen und Eigenschaften von Salzen aus dem Ionenaufbau erklären.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can derive salt ratio formulas from ion charges and molecular ions, translate between salt names and formulas, and explain salt properties from ionic structure.
records.generatorProvenance: Raw sealed author input identifies ChatGPT/Codex builtin image generation; model id not separately exposed. Generator identity is not approval.
scienceAndRepresentationObservations: The actual Al2O3 output now has exactly2 Al3+ spheres and3 O2- spheres. The corrected ratio agrees with the formula.
NaCl:1(+1)+1(-1)=0; MgCl2:1(+2)+2(-1)=0; Al2O3:2(+3)+3(-2)=0. Names and written formula ratios are correct.

At360, three parallel panels plus a fourth hydration/brittleness panel make ion superscript charges and the three charge-sum expressions tiny. Their legibility requires knowledge from the native/680 image rather than independent reading at phone width.
records.actual360Verdict: FAIL: central charge and charge-balance details are too small in the actual360 view. Native and680 resolve the correction; that does not remove the phone failure.
records.actual680Verdict: Personally seen: main motifs and detailed labels visible at680; any remaining geometry boundary explicitly retained.
records.representationAndScopeLimit: Ratio-formula examples and a schematic NaCl property inset, not salt molecules or whole molecular-ion/task coverage.
records.requiredCorrection: Use a larger charge-balance example (for example the corrected2 Al3+/3 O2- motif) with clearly legible charge signs and formula. Reduce parallel panels/ancillary text while preserving the image style. Reinspect the actual resulting360/680 raster.
records.proposedBoundedAltTextDE: Drei neutrale Salz-Verhältnisformeln: NaCl im Ionenverhältnis 1:1, MgCl₂ im Verhältnis 1:2 und Al₂O₃ im Verhältnis 2:3. Jeweils gleichen sich positive und negative Ladungen aus; ein NaCl-Beispiel zeigt bewegliche hydratisierte Ionen und einen spröden Kristall.

records.title: Salzbildung energetisch mit Gitterenergie erklären
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Salzbildung aus Elementen als Ionenbildung mit Elektronenübergang beschreiben, die Edelgaskonfiguration mithilfe des Energiestufenmodells begründen und den exothermen Verlauf über Gitterenergie als Triebkraft erklären.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can describe salt formation from elements as ion formation through electron transfer, justify noble-gas configuration using the energy level model, and explain the exothermic course through lattice energy as the driving force.
records.generatorProvenance: Raw sealed author input identifies ChatGPT/Codex builtin image generation; model id not separately exposed. Generator identity is not approval.
scienceAndRepresentationObservations: Schematic energy axis points upward. Preparation from Na(s)+1/2 Cl2(g) to separated gaseous Na+/Cl- is drawn at a higher level; lattice formation leads to a lower level than the elemental starting state. The overall stated ΔH<0 is consistent.
Gas-ion occupancies2|8 and2|8|8 are correct. Numeric occupancies avoid the old sparse falsely counted Na+ shell model.
Alternating + and - crystal motif is an ionic lattice region, not an isolated NaCl molecule or exact count of a complete crystal.

At360 the energy axis, net rise, larger fall, charged ions/crystal motif and overall exothermic statement remain clear. The small individual gas-ion occupancy labels are ancillary to this energy-orientation figure, not a readable electron-count task. At680 they are also legible.
records.actual360Verdict: PASS for the chosen energetic orientation: rise/fall and exothermic endpoint are visually clear at360, with no need to read a dense dataset. Small ancillary shell labels do not stand in for P evidence.
records.actual680Verdict: Personally seen: main motifs and detailed labels visible at680; any remaining geometry boundary explicitly retained.
records.representationAndScopeLimit: Qualitative aggregated Born-Haber-style preparation/lattice picture; no quantitative lattice energy, full individual-step cycle or complete mastery evidence.
records.proposedBoundedAltTextDE: Schematischer Energieverlauf der Bildung von NaCl: Die Vorbereitung von Natrium und Chlor zu gasförmigen Na⁺- und Cl⁻-Ionen kostet netto Energie. Die anschließende Gitterbildung setzt mehr Energie frei; NaCl liegt energetisch tiefer und die Gesamtänderung ist exotherm.
records.altTextStatus: inert proposal; for REVISE assets only after the actual image defect is resolved. Alt text does not fix raster legibility or geometry.

records.title: Bindungs- und Molekülpolarität ableiten
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Elektronegativitätsunterschiede zur Erklärung von Bindungspolaritäten nutzen, daraus mit der Molekülgeometrie die Molekülpolarität ableiten und Elektronendichte- sowie ladungscodierte Oberflächendarstellungen interpretieren.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can use electronegativity differences to explain bond polarities, derive molecular polarity from bond polarity and molecular geometry, and interpret electron-density and charge-coded surface representations.
records.generatorProvenance: Raw sealed author input identifies ChatGPT/Codex builtin image generation; model id not separately exposed. Generator identity is not approval.
scienceAndRepresentationObservations: The old falsely four-electron H ring is gone. H and Cl are now element symbols without false occupancy dots.
H2 has no electronegativity difference and no polar bond; HCl shows Hδ+ and Clδ- with polarization toward Cl.

Linear CO2 shows Cδ+ and Oδ- at both ends; equal opposite C-O dipoles cancel. The symmetric charge-coded surface is consistent with no net molecular dipole. Color is qualitative and label-bound, not a computed quantitative density surface.

At360 the three instructional columns contain many lines of text. Partial-charge signs, surface legend and surface charge labels are very small; these matter directly for the current goal of interpreting charge-coded surfaces.
records.actual360Verdict: FAIL: δ+/δ- and surface interpretation details cannot be relied on as independently readable at actual360. The actual680 view is substantially clearer.
records.actual680Verdict: Personally seen: main motifs and detailed labels visible at680; any remaining geometry boundary explicitly retained.
records.representationAndScopeLimit: Qualitative EN/bond/molecular-polarity models; magnet/scale metaphors and color patches do not measure EN or electron density.
records.requiredCorrection: Simplify around larger bond-dipole and molecular-dipole motifs with visible partial charges and a readable qualitative surface key. Remove redundant panel prose; inspect actual360/680 again.
records.proposedBoundedAltTextDE: Qualitative Modelle zeigen eine unpolare H₂-Bindung, die polare HCl-Bindung in Richtung Chlor und lineares CO₂: Die beiden C–O-Bindungsdipole sind entgegengesetzt und ergeben keinen Gesamtdipol. Farbflächen und δ-Zeichen zeigen schematisch die relative Ladungsverteilung.

records.title: Valenzstrichformeln und Mesomerie aufstellen
records.description: Die lernende Person kann mithilfe der Edelgasregel die Bindigkeit von Nichtmetall-Atomen vorhersagen und Valenzstrichformeln von Molekülen sowie ausgewählten Molekül-Ionen unter Einbezug mesomerer Grenzstrukturen aufstellen.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can predict the valency of nonmetal atoms using the noble-gas rule and construct valence-line formulas of molecules and selected molecular ions including mesomeric resonance structures.
records.generatorProvenance: Raw sealed author input identifies ChatGPT/Codex builtin image generation; model id not separately exposed. Generator identity is not approval.
scienceAndRepresentationObservations: The actual selected molecule ion is nitrite NO2-, which is allowed by the current goal wording selected molecular ions. The goal/DE/EN scope is unchanged; the nitrate example is not a fixed goal requirement.

Both resonance forms preserve atom positions and swap the single/double bond. Left form: double O4 free dots, single O6 free dots, N2 free dots; right form has6,4,2 respectively. Each has12 nonbonding+6 bonding=18 valence electrons.

The independent elemental calculation5(N)+2×6(O)+1(charge)=18 agrees. N and both O atoms each have an octet. Single-bond O carries formal -1; the overall brackets are -1. Left form uses the overall bracket charge rather than an extra local O label; this does not change the correct Lewis count.
The resonance double arrow denotes resonance structures, not atom movement or alternating real molecules.
At360 both atoms, bond multiplicities, individual free-pair dots, bracket charge and18-electron label remain distinguishable. Actual680 also passes.
records.actual360Verdict: PASS: the reduced two-form layout retains the scientifically important dots and bond multiplicities at360 and680.
records.actual680Verdict: Personally seen: main motifs and detailed labels visible at680; any remaining geometry boundary explicitly retained.
records.representationAndScopeLimit: One selected molecular-ion example; no global coverage of all valence-line or nitrate task cases.
records.proposedBoundedAltTextDE: Zwei mesomere Grenzstrukturen des Nitritions NO₂⁻ haben gleiche Atompositionen, aber vertauschte Einfach- und Doppelbindungen. Je Form sind 18 Valenzelektronen und vollständige Oktette dargestellt; die Gesamtladung ist −1.

records.title: Unterenergiestufen aus Spektren und Ionisierungsenergien ableiten
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Emissionsspektren, Flammenfarben und erste Ionisierungsenergien ausgewählter Hauptgruppen-Atome als experimentelle Hinweise auf Unterenergiestufen deuten und daraus Haupt- und Nebenquantenzahl ableiten.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can interpret emission spectra, flame colors, and first ionization energies of selected main-group atoms as experimental evidence for sub-energy levels and infer principal and angular-momentum quantum numbers.
records.generatorProvenance: Raw sealed author input identifies ChatGPT/Codex builtin image generation; model id not separately exposed. Generator identity is not approval.
scienceAndRepresentationObservations: The O point1314 is now below N1402 but above C1086 and Be900, with a modest N-to-O fall. The previously contradictory ordinate is corrected.
All eight written first-ionization labels round correctly from independently retrieved NIST neutral Li-Ne I reference data.
The illustrative sublevels1s,2s,2p,3s,3p and n=1/2/3 labels are consistent. ℓ=0 maps to s and ℓ=1 to p; these are examples, not a claim that higher ℓ never exist.

At360 the central numerical labels are only a few pixels high, and the ℓ/s/p explanatory line is small. These are essential to interpreting the experimentally motivated sublevel example and distinguishing the two quantum numbers.
records.actual360Verdict: FAIL: the eight energy labels and n/ℓ legend are not independently readable at actual360, although the overall trend shape is recognizable and680 is clearer.
records.actual680Verdict: Personally seen: main motifs and detailed labels visible at680; any remaining geometry boundary explicitly retained.
records.representationAndScopeLimit: Illustrative spectrum and selected neutral-atom energies; not a measured specified flame spectrum, orbital drawing to scale or proof that line energies equal first ionization energies.
records.requiredCorrection: Reduce the dense panel payload and enlarge the experimentally relevant labels and n/ℓ comparison. Retain correct N/O and Be/B trends and recheck actual360/680.
records.proposedBoundedAltTextDE: Ein schematisches Linienspektrum und die ersten Ionisierungsenergien von Lithium bis Neon geben Hinweise auf Unterenergiestufen. Ein Modell zeigt 1s, 2s, 2p, 3s und 3p sowie Hauptquantenzahl n und Nebenquantenzahl ℓ mit ℓ=0 für s und ℓ=1 für p.

records.title: Partikelgröße und Oberflächen-Volumen-Verhältnis deuten
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Größenordnungen von Stoffteilchen, Nanopartikeln und makroskopischen Objekten vergleichen und Änderungen von Stoffeigenschaften durch Partikelgröße sowie Oberflächen-Volumen-Verhältnis erklären.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can compare the orders of magnitude of particles, nanoparticles and macroscopic objects and explain changes in material properties through particle size and surface-area-to-volume ratio.
records.generatorProvenance: Raw sealed author input identifies ChatGPT/Codex builtin image generation; model id not separately exposed. Generator identity is not approval.
scienceAndRepresentationObservations: The formerly universal atoms/molecules<1nm statement is corrected to small H2O as an example, with an explicit larger-macromolecule qualification. Nanoparticles are bounded as typically1-100nm.
The bottom shows exactly8 separate cubes in2 rows of4. The stated mathematical intention is correct:8×(a/2)^3=a^3 and total surface8×6(a/2)^2=12a^2 versus6a^2.

However, the actual same-view small cube front edges are about0.36 of the large edge, not0.5, while labels are a and a/2 and equal total volume is asserted without a not-to-scale qualification. The native and actual360/680 drawings retain this discrepancy.

Top panels are separate scale examples; the bottom is a material-particle subdivision scheme, not a literal cut into individual water molecules. Conditional can accelerate reaction wording avoids claiming every size reduction universally increases reaction rate.
records.actual360Verdict: Principal size examples and eight-cube count are recognizable at360 and680; the geometry discrepancy is present at both sizes. Small supplementary macromolecule text is clearer at680, while small molecule and z.B. H2O already limit the core example at360.
records.actual680Verdict: Personally seen: main motifs and detailed labels visible at680; any remaining geometry boundary explicitly retained.
records.representationAndScopeLimit: Material-particle geometric subdivision only; no universal maximal atomic surface or unrestricted kinetic/size law.
records.requiredCorrection: Make the corresponding small edges visually half the large edge at comparable perspective, or add an explicit readable schematic/not-to-scale qualifier. Preserve8 visible cubes and the valid a/a2 volume/surface concept; then inspect the actual new raster again.
records.proposedBoundedAltTextDE: Beispiele vergleichen ein kleines H₂O-Molekül unter 1 nm, Nanopartikel typischerweise von 1 bis 100 nm und ein Alltagsobjekt; Makromoleküle können größer sein. Ein beschriftetes Würfelschema erklärt, dass Unterteilung bei gleichem Gesamtvolumen mehr äußere Oberfläche ergibt.
